defaults.targetRunoff: light runoff during calibration, then minimal excess once tuned
defaults.phRange: 5.8-6.3 for many leafy greens and herbs

ibcCirculation.normal: Run before or around feed cycles so the secured top-discharge hose keeps the batch distributed
ibcCirculation.afterNutrients: Run continuously until the fresh batch is evenly blended
ibcCirculation.hotWeather: Increase observation and mixing frequency if plant response, odor, or visible circulation indicates a need

baseTasks.title: Plant or transplant
baseTasks.note: Confirm feed line is flushed, towers are stable, and media is evenly moist.

baseTasks.title: First flow check
baseTasks.note: Confirm every tower receives water and note runoff after a feed cycle.

baseTasks.title: Tank, mixing circulation, and pH check
baseTasks.note: Check tank level, pump intake, and the secured mixing-pump top discharge. Record pH if measured; do not routinely top off or re-dose the batch.

baseTasks.title: Plant development and refill-window check
baseTasks.note: Review water level and plant development. EC/TDS is optional. Prepare the next strength only when the tank is nearly empty and a fresh batch will be mixed.

baseTasks.title: Flush feed hose end
baseTasks.note: Open the end-of-hose valve/nozzle and flush debris from the main feed line.

lettuce.title: Light leaf harvest
lettuce.note: Harvest outside leaves if growth is strong.

lettuce.title: Main lettuce harvest window
lettuce.note: Harvest or succession plant before bitterness increases.

basil.title: First basil pinch
basil.note: Cut above a node to encourage branching.

basil.title: Regular basil harvest
basil.note: Harvest stems above nodes and avoid removing more than one-third at once.

cilantro.title: First cilantro harvest
cilantro.note: Cut outer stems and avoid removing the center.

strawberry.title: Flower and pollination check
strawberry.note: Support pollination indoors with airflow or hand pollination.

strawberry.title: Runner trim
strawberry.note: Remove runners if fruit production is the priority.

tomato.title: Review tomato development
tomato.note: At the next fresh refill, choose the growing or fruiting recipe from actual flowering and production.

tomato.title: Prune lower growth
tomato.note: Remove weak lower leaves and add support.

peppers.title: Pepper support check
peppers.note: Check stem strength and add support before flowering.

peppers.title: Flower and fruit watch
peppers.note: Keep pH steady and watch for heat stress.

mixed greens.title: First cut-and-come-again harvest
mixed greens.note: Clip outer leaves and keep crowns intact.

mixed greens.title: Succession planting reminder
mixed greens.note: Start another batch to keep harvests steady.
